metadata.description: Name of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace.
Unique identifier for the analytics rule.

properties.displayName: SQL-DB-usecase1 - Access to SQL Database after Office Hours - SecurityEvent
properties.description: Detects successful SQL Server instance logins recorded as MSSQLSERVER SecurityEvent 18454 when a non-whitelisted login signs in outside approved business hours. Event 18454 does not identify the accessed database. Update the timezone, approved hours, and whitelist before enabling in production.
properties.query:
let BusinessTimeZone = "Asia/Singapore";
let BusinessStartHour = 8;
let BusinessEndHour = 18;
let WhitelistedDatabaseUsers = dynamic(["replace_with_approved_user", "replace_with_service_account"]);
SecurityEvent
| where EventSourceName =~ "MSSQLSERVER" and EventID == 18454
| extend ParsedEventData = trim(" ", replace_regex(replace_regex(EventData, @"<[^>]+>", " "), @"\s+", " "))
| extend DatabaseUser = extract(@"^([^ ]+)", 1, ParsedEventData)
| extend SourceClient = extract(@"(?i)\[CLIENT:\s*([^\]]+)\]", 1, ParsedEventData)
| extend SourceClient = replace_string(SourceClient, "<local machine>", "local machine")
| where isnotempty(DatabaseUser)
| where DatabaseUser !in~ (WhitelistedDatabaseUsers)
| extend LocalEventTime = datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated, BusinessTimeZone)
| extend LocalHour = datetime_part("Hour", LocalEventTime), LocalDay = dayofweek(LocalEventTime)
| where LocalDay !between (1d .. 5d) or LocalHour < BusinessStartHour or LocalHour >= BusinessEndHour
| extend DatabaseHost = Computer
| extend SourceIpAddress = iff(SourceClient matches regex @"^(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$" or SourceClient contains ":", SourceClient, "")
| project TimeGenerated, LocalEventTime, DatabaseUser, DatabaseHost, SourceClient, SourceIpAddress, Computer, EventID, EventSourceName, EventLevelName

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: SQL database login by {{DatabaseUser}} outside business hours
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Database user {{DatabaseUser}} successfully logged in to SQL Server host {{DatabaseHost}} at {{LocalEventTime}} outside approved business hours.
